params.name: criterion
params.why: CART's criterion; cheaper than entropy (no logarithms) and rarely disagrees — both are shown in the hand-verification panel.

params.name: max_depth
params.why: Chosen from 1–15 by stratified 5-fold CV AUC on the training split (best CV AUC 0.7820). With duration the best depth was 7.

params.name: min_samples_leaf
params.why: Pre-pruning: no leaf may describe fewer than 50 clients, so leaf rates are not small-sample noise (cf. education=illiterate, 18 rows).

params.name: class_weight
params.why: Only 11.27% subscribe; without reweighting the impurity criterion is dominated by the 'no' class.

params.name: encoding
params.why: sklearn trees need numeric input; one-hot keeps each level as a separate yes/no question.

params.name: random_state
params.why: Ties between equally good splits are broken randomly; fixing the seed makes the tree reproducible.
